content.title: Dwarf Star Upgrades
content.body:
§lWeapons:
      - Dwarf Star Ranged/Melee weapons
    §lBaubles:
      - Golden Heart
      - Wither Ring
      - Stone of Inertia Null
      - Godly Empty Ring (for permanent potion effects)
      - Gluttony Pendant: Made with a §oHoney Bucket §r(In the Nether's §oHives§r), and a Lvl 3 §oWraith Skull §r(Upgraded with the §oEquipment Infuser§r). 
      - Wrath Pendant: Made with a §oBlood Bucket §r(In the §oFlesh Biome§r), and a Lvl 3 §oBehemophet Claw §r(Upgraded with the §oEquipment Infuser§r).
    §lArmor:
      §l- Tremor: 
      1. Oureclasse: Ore found in the §oDeep Caverns §rat Y = 128-192.
      2. Desichalkos: Crafted with an §oalloy §rof §oHeart Dust §rand §oGrave Dust§r.
      §l- Furor:
      1. Vulcanite
      2. Electrum: Crafted with and §oalloy §rof §oSilver §rand §oGold§r.
      §l- Devout:
      1. Ignatius
      2. Midasium
      §l- Arcum:
      1. Kalendrite
      2. Carmot: Ore found in the §oDeep Caverns §rat Y = 5-10
